name: flyscanner-workspace
description: Cross-platform helper scripts for Flyscanner (Windows / macOS / Linux)

scripts.web: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.demo: npm run web && cargo run -- --demo --lat 52.52 --lon 13.405 --db data/flyscanner.db
scripts.docker:full: docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml -f deploy/docker-compose.sdr.yml --profile full up --build
scripts.fmt: cargo fmt --all && npm --prefix frontend run format
scripts.lint: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm --prefix frontend run check
scripts.pics: npm run pics:banner && npm run pics:social
